dct_title_s: Platte grondt der verbrande Stadt London
dct_alternative_sm: Platte grondt der verbrande Stadt London
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Scale statement, "Diss ist ein halbe Englische Meijle ...," appears within a drawing of a drafting compass.; Coordinates not present on map and are approximated.; Includes inset map of Robert Hooke's 1667 plan for the rebuilding of London, "Modell der abgebrandten Stadt London new zu bawen".; Includes illustration: perspective view of the Great Fire, "Londons Brandt".; Title is displayed in a decorative cartouche of a red drapery with gold fringe. At left is the coat of arms of Great Britain, with a golden crown. At right is the coat of arms of the City of London, crowned with laurels.
